beats.decision: Keep the name Calder House or rename the gym; Mara is waiting in the locker room.
beats.tutorial_line: You have the keys and a lease. You don't throw punches here - you keep the doors open.

beats.decision: Read Mara's 6 core stats and 2 readouts, then pick her first focus: Recovery Rate or Cut & Swell Resistance.
beats.tutorial_line: Six numbers say what she can do. Recovery Rate and Cut & Swell Resistance say how long she can keep doing it.

beats.decision: Set the 1-2 as Mara's first drilled technique; see what it opens in the tree.
beats.tutorial_line: Every combination starts with a jab and a straight right. Drill it until her hands stop thinking.

beats.decision: Fill Mara's week with stations, or keep the coach's default week.
beats.tutorial_line: A week is seven days of choices. Push her and she grows; push too hard and she wears.

beats.decision: Watch the day play out or press Advance; the floor runs the plan either way.
beats.tutorial_line: You don't need to stand over every round on the bag. Advance when you've seen enough.

beats.decision: Read where the week landed on her body and keep or ease next week's plan.
beats.tutorial_line: Stats went up. So did the wear on her shoulders. Both carry into Monday.

beats.decision: Accept the amateur draw against Elena Perez and spend on film to read her tells.
beats.tutorial_line: Elena Perez drops her right hand when she lunges with the hook. Pay to look, or find out in the ring.

beats.decision: Watch the pacing; drag the Towel Tray only if she is badly hurt.
beats.tutorial_line: The corner stays quiet during rounds. Trust the week and watch her body.

beats.decision: Spend Chief Second 15s (1 AP) on a tone; Second lane 15s (1 AP) on Water/Stamina (+8%).
beats.tutorial_line: Read her pulse and her state. Match the tone: Calm, Fire Her Up, or Tell Her the Truth.

beats.decision: Hear the verdict, then pick your word to her: praise the work or warn about the trades she took.
beats.tutorial_line: Win or lose, the card is on the ledger. The next one is already being drawn.

beats.decision: Pay the month's bill, then answer Cass Orth's Northline development deal: sign, refuse, or delay 4 weeks.
beats.tutorial_line: The bill came on its date. Cass Orth came with it, smiling, holding a contract with Mara's name already on it.

beats.screen: Booking: Regional Card, then GymHall3D Fight Week Thursday
beats.decision: Book Mara on the regional card Hale Yard shares; at Thursday's test spar, Lock One, Sacrifice One: lock Right Cross Power (+15% crit) or keep Low Hook Guard (-10% vs left hooks if dropped).
beats.tutorial_line: Rook Hale's gym is on the same card. Thursday's spar is the last test: lock one weapon, give up one guard.

beats.decision: Weight cut: Safe Sweat (-5% stamina) or Sauna Push (10% fail risk, -15% chin).
beats.tutorial_line: Hale Yard is watching from across the room. Drain the water, or drain the chin.

beats.decision: Read the swelling under her eye; decide whether the corner calls for the clinch.
beats.tutorial_line: Her eye is closing. Less vision means more shots she doesn't see coming.

beats.decision: Cutman lane: Ice (swelling) or Swab (cut). Then the doctor looks: drag the towel to ring centre, or wave the doctor off and fight on (risk Cut-Prone scar).
beats.tutorial_line: The doctor is looking at her. Throw the towel to protect the career, or trust her to see the round out.

beats.decision: Read the week's result on the Wall, then Advance into the full gym.
beats.tutorial_line: The doors are still open. Everything in the gym is yours now.
